method: GNU time -v maximum RSS in KiB; sorted unique complete tagged output lines joined by LF with no trailing LF, no text/path normalization. The default/arena2/Rust-only allocator experiments use an immutable scanner built from merged master 50c7c7907f2. The full-override experiment also contains the borrowing and masked-view changes, using the same pinned preexisting dependency versions. Some runs overlap and other host activity/build caches are uncontrolled. Generated inventory entries varied slightly; byte counts are recorded in logs. RSS differences alone do not establish a precise fragmentation or per-rule allocation attribution.
